# Parameter and limit ledger

| Symbol | Value/range | Meaning | Uniformity |
|---|---:|---|---|
| block | \(I_2^4\) | 81 vertices, 216 links, 216 plaquettes | fixed |
| group | \(SU(2)\) | unit-three-sphere normalization | fixed |
| generator | \(\frac12\Delta\) | heat kernel convention | fixed |
| \(r\) | \(10^{-5}\) | plaquettewise link-log radius | closed chart |
| \(t\) | \(0<t\le10^{-18}\) | heat time | uniform in displayed interval |
| \(\|y\|\) | \(\le r/20\) | retained cylinder | uniform |
| \(\|z\|\) | \(\le r/2\) | fiber cylinder | uniform |
| volume | none | no growing lattice | not applicable |
| spacing \(a\) | none | no continuum scaling | not applicable |
| RG step \(k\) | one marginal only | no iteration | not applicable |

Limit order: there is no limit in the theorem. The interval includes arbitrarily
small positive heat times, at fixed block and fixed coordinate radii.
